JCW LUNACY - SYNTHESIZED ARCADE SFX STARTER PACK

44 individual original procedurally synthesized effects. Mono 44.1 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV. No sampled recordings. Male/female oofs are synthetic formant-based game grunts, not human performances.

PREVIEW.wav plays one example from each category in this order:
weapon_swing
punch_hit
kick_hit
body_slam_ring
chair_hit
trashcan_hit
bat_hit
guitar_smash
ring_footstep
rope_bounce
jump_landing
ring_bell
male_oof_synthetic
female_oof_synthetic

Use manifest.json to map files to game events. Randomly select variations on each hit. Trigger swing at weapon movement, impact at contact, slam at mat contact. Layer one oof over a hit at lower volume. Keep headroom when layering (start effects around 0.5 gain). Footsteps are individual steps, not loops. These are initial synthesized assets for audition; realism and suitability need listening review.
